# spacelift_azure_integration (List Resource)

Lists every Azure integration in the account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_child_spaces` (Boolean) With `space_id`, also list Azure integrations in its child spaces, at any depth.
- `labels` (List of String) Only list Azure integrations that have all of these labels.
- `name` (String) Only list Azure integrations whose name matches this pattern. `*` matches any characters, and case is ignored.
- `space_id` (String) Only list Azure integrations in this space.
